Interface LobbyCommandVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
LobbyManager
public interface LobbyCommandVisitor
Visitor over LobbyCommand. Every method has a no-op default so that implementors can override only the cases they care about: the LobbyManager handles the user-facing menu commands (create/join/ list/leave), the registrations and the disconnections (register-socket/ register-rmi/disconnect); the GameController handles the lifecycle commands that mutate the model (disconnect/reconnect/suspension-timeout).
